title.narrative: Africa-Europe Partnerships for Culture: Promoting Culture and Heritage-based Sustainable Tourism in Southern Africa

description.narrative: The project “Africa-Europe Partnerships for Culture: Promoting Culture and Heritage-based Sustainable Tourism in Southern Africa”, a European Union project implemented by UNESCO, will contribute to strengthening the contribution of culture and heritage to sustainable development, notably through enhancing culture and heritage-based tourism development, diversifying tourism products and delivering high-quality visitor experiences at selected UNESCO-designated sites and cities. These activities aim to contribute to improving livelihoods of the communities in the region, including youth, women and indigenous peoples, through capacity building and the creation of opportunities for income-generation and jobs.
